title: Switchyard Configuration
description: Configuration for the Switchyard extension. Resolves virtual models to target models with NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard routing algorithms.

virtual_models.description: Virtual models resolved by the filter. The first entry whose name and match_headers match the request wins.

name.description: The model name clients send in the request body, for example "coding-auto".

targets.description: Switchyard target names, as used in the algorithm configuration, mapped to the model names they route to.

algorithm.description: The Switchyard algorithm, in Switchyard's route configuration format. Every Switchyard algorithm except prefill_router is supported. Judges resolve to decision_targets, then judge_targets, then the virtual model's own targets, which are called through model_calls.

default_model.description: Model used when routing fails and failure_mode is use_default. Must be one of the target models.

failure_mode.description: What to do when routing fails. Defaults to use_default when default_model is set, and to passthrough otherwise.

match_headers.description: Request headers that must have the given values for this virtual model to apply.

decision_targets.description: Judge models that return typed decisions, such as Jev, by judge name. Algorithms refer to them by name, for example in classifier_target.

format.description: API format of the decision endpoint.

model.description: The provider model name sent in the request body, for example "jev-latest".

cluster.description: The Envoy cluster the judge calls are sent to.

authority.description: The :authority (host) of the judge calls, for example "api.typesafe.ai".

path.description: Request path. Defaults to /v1/systemone for system_one and /v1/decisions for openai_decisions.

api_key.description: Optional API key. Sent as authorization: Bearer <key>, or as x-api-key for anthropic_messages.

headers.description: Extra request headers. Names are lowercased.

timeout_ms.description: Timeout of each judge call, in milliseconds. Defaults to 5000.

judge_targets.description: Judge models called with a chat request, by judge name. A name must not also appear in decision_targets.

format.description: API format of the judge model.

model.description: The provider model name sent in the request body, for example "jev-latest".

cluster.description: The Envoy cluster the judge calls are sent to.

authority.description: The :authority (host) of the judge calls, for example "api.typesafe.ai".

path.description: Request path. Defaults to /v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses or /v1/messages, by format.

api_key.description: Optional API key. Sent as authorization: Bearer <key>, or as x-api-key for anthropic_messages.

headers.description: Extra request headers. Names are lowercased.

timeout_ms.description: Timeout of each judge call, in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.

model_calls.description: How the filter calls target models of the gateway: judges named by a target key, vgr's efficient attempt, and advisor's executor and advisor. Required when an algorithm makes such calls. Point the cluster at the gateway itself, so that it applies credentials, rate limits, costs and telemetry to the calls.

cluster.description: The Envoy cluster the calls are sent to, usually a loopback cluster to the gateway.

authority.description: The :authority of the calls. Defaults to the client request's.

path.description: Request path. Defaults to the client request's path, or to the standard path of format when it differs from the client's.

format.description: API format of the calls. Defaults to the client request's.

timeout_ms.description: Timeout of each call, in milliseconds. Defaults to 10000.

forward_headers.description: Client request headers copied to the calls, such as credentials, tenant and session headers.

headers.description: Extra request headers added to the calls.

eligible_models_header.description: Optional request header holding comma-separated model names. The algorithm only sees eligible targets, and routing fails when none is eligible. Judges are not limited. Must be set by a trusted filter, never by the client.

routing_headers.description: Whether to add the x-switchyard-routing-calls, -input-tokens, -output-tokens and -total-tokens response headers to routed responses and answers. Defaults to false.

session.description: How the session identity used by stateful algorithms is read from the request headers.

id_header.description: Header carrying the session ID. Defaults to x-switchyard-session-id.

fallback_id_headers.description: Headers checked, in order, when id_header is not set. Defaults to ["agent-session-id"].

scope_headers.description: Headers whose values prefix the session ID, for example a tenant header, so that sessions are never shared across scopes.

agent_id_header.description: Header carrying the agent ID. Sub-agent requests need it to keep their own session state. Defaults to x-switchyard-agent-id.

subagent_header.description: Header flagging sub-agent requests with "true" or "1". Sub-agent requests are routed by the subagents block of the algorithm, when set. Defaults to x-switchyard-is-subagent.

endpoints.description: Request path suffixes handled by the filter, mapped to the API format of their bodies. Defaults to the OpenAI chat completions, OpenAI responses and Anthropic messages endpoints.

model_header.description: Optional request header set to the selected model, for routing on plain Envoy. Not needed with Agent Router.

clear_route_cache.description: Whether to clear the route cache after a model is selected. Not needed with Agent Router, which clears it itself. Defaults to false.

decision_headers.description: Whether to add the x-switchyard-virtual-model, x-switchyard-selected-model and x-switchyard-reason request headers. Defaults to true.

rewrite_body.description: Whether to rewrite the model field of the request body to the selected model. Set to false to keep the virtual model in the body and carry the decision only in the decision headers, model_header, dynamic metadata and filter state, so that a later filter can apply its own policy before it picks the backend. Defaults to true.

TraceContext.description: Trace context sent with each call: w3c (traceparent), b3 (x-b3-* headers) or none. Defaults to w3c.

DataSource.description: A value given inline or read from a file. A file is read once at config load and trimmed of surrounding whitespace.
